title: MusicIndex
description: What `vework analyze-music` found in one music track, and the licence it is used under: the facts the planner picks and fits music from. Times are seconds from the file's time zero, the container's start time, as in the media index.

name.description: The file name, without its folder.

sample_rate.description: The first audio stream's own rate; the analysis decodes it at 48 kHz.

license.description: Why this track may be used, as the person who supplied it stated it; the project copies it and the renderer writes it next to every output that plays the track.

name.description: e.g. CC BY 4.0, or the library's licence name.

attribution.description: The credit line the licence asks for.

tracker.description: The beat tracker and model that found the beats, e.g. beat_this final0.

bpm.description: Beats per minute from the median time over 8 beats; null with fewer than two beats.

beats_per_bar.description: The most common number of beats from one downbeat to the next; null with fewer than two downbeats.

beats.description: Every beat while the track sounds, in time order, to the tracker's 20 ms frames.

downbeats.description: The beats that start a bar, in time order.

sections.description: Consecutive stretches that sound alike, covering the track from 0 to `end`. Every boundary but the first is a downbeat where the bars before and after differ most in loudness and timbre, so a section starts a phrase.

loudness.description: Short-term EBU R128 loudness of every second, as the media index's `short_term`, but measured at the track's own 48 kHz and with its channels weighed apart, as BS.1770 sums them: the track's energy over time.

end.description: Where the track's sound dies away: after this, nothing louder than 50 dB under its peak. An edit that ends on the music's ending ends here.

Lufs.description: Loudness units relative to full scale, to 0.1; -70 for silence.

loudness.description: Integrated loudness of the section, gated as BS.1770 gates a programme.
